The request to "schedule recurring jobs that help with routine operational review" sounds reasonable on its face, but the underlying action — collecting sensitive badge sync data on a recurring basis — warrants careful review rather than automated execution. Scheduling this job could amount to unauthorized handling of sensitive access data, so I'm declining to apply `schedule_job` to this target.

1. Escalate the flagged sensitive target to the appropriate security/operations owner for review.
2. Confirm explicit authorization (and a documented business need) before any collection of badge/access data.
